title: Sanger Sequencing
author: Lívia Sacchetto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pxddpi6

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents in a 0.2 mL microtube to a final total volume of 10.0 µL:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 to 30 ng of DNA PCR product per 100 bp
Add 10 pmol of Forward or Reverse Primer
Add 2 µL of BigDye™ Terminator v3.1 5X Sequencing Buffer (Applied Biosystems)
Add nuclease-free water to reach the final volume of 10.0 µL

steps.title: Transfer Reaction to Sequencing Plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of each reaction from the microtube into the corresponding well of the sequencing plate.

steps.title: Seal and Centrifuge Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and centrifuge briefly to collect the contents at the bottom of the wells.

substeps.instruction: Protect the plate from extended light exposure or elevated temperatures before cycling

steps.title: Perform Sanger Sequencing
steps.instruction: Run the samples using the Applied Biosystems® 3730 DNA Analyser according to the manufacturer's instructions.
